{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs/task-33ac569e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Slide each four-connected nonzero object as far right as possible."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    # Settle rightmost objects first so each object can stop against them.
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: max(c for _, c in obj[1]), reverse=True)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    occupied = set()
    for color, cells in objects:
        shift = 0
        while True:
            next_shift = shift + 1
            if any(c + next_shift >= w or (r, c + next_shift) in occupied
                   for r, c in cells):
                break
            shift = next_shift
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r][c + shift] = color
            occupied.add((r, c + shift))
    return out
"
}
